content.text: {"Id":"BUG-TRIAGE-114","Title":"sessionlog_query fails: SessionLogs missing agent header columns","Section":"Backlog","Priority":"high","Done":false,"Estimate":null,"Note":null,"Description":["sessionlog_query against F:\\GitHub\\TruckMate fails because EF maps SessionLogEntity.AgentSessionId, AgentSessionTranscriptFile, AgentExecutablePath, and AgentExecutableVersion, but the workspace store has not applied migration 20260722214500_AddAgentSessionHeaderFields (adds those four nullable columns to SessionLogs). The error text matches SQL Server Invalid column name failures. Other MCP tools work; impact is scoped to session-log read/query (and any other SessionLogs SELECT/INSERT path). Transient transport errors during retries are consistent with a mid-restart/mid-migration window on a shared MCP instance.","Triage group: triage-group-377316ffc2567e19","Reports: 1"],"TechnicalDetails":["Acceptance criteria:","- sessionlog_query against workspacePath F:\\GitHub\\TruckMate returns results (or an empty page) without SQL Invalid column name errors for AgentSessionId, AgentSessionTranscriptFile, AgentExecutablePath, or AgentExecutableVersion","- SessionLogs physical schema includes nullable AgentSessionId, AgentSessionTranscriptFile, AgentExecutablePath, and AgentExecutableVersion columns matching SessionLogEntity and migration 20260722214500_AddAgentSessionHeaderFields","- After a clean server start, McpDatabaseMigrationCoordinator.ApplyMigrationsAsync reports migration 20260722214500_AddAgentSessionHeaderFields applied for the provider/database used by that workspace","- sessionlog_query with and without a text filter (limits 1-200) succeeds on TruckMate; triage_status and unrelated tools remain unaffected","Implementation notes:","- Root cause is schema-migration drift, not a bad sessionlog_query filter: SessionLogService maps the four agent header fields on every entity projection; any SessionLogs SELECT fails until columns exist.","- Fix path: apply EF migration 20260722214500_AddAgentSessionHeaderFields via normal startup (Program.cs / McpStdioHost -\u003E McpDatabaseMigrationCoordinator.ApplyMigrationsAsync) or an explicit Migrate against the TruckMate/shared provider database; restart if the process was mid-deploy.","- Migration Up() adds four nullable TEXT columns (max lengths 256/2048/2048/128) to SessionLogs; Down() drops them. No Designer.cs for this migration; snapshot already includes the properties.","- Error message format (Invalid column name) indicates SQL Server (or compatible); confirm provider before hand-running SQL.
